name: Kazu Data Course
description: Kazu Data Course — a theme for a solo instructor's online course. A quiet #F8F8F8 ground with thin ink Lora type: an oversized display headline set flush to the left edge of the screen, a framed 3:4 portrait with the instructor's name running vertically over its edge, and white cards with a hard plum-tint offset edge and a pill label on the top border. Alternating photo and text chapters, student work over a pale stone watermark ring, one clear price and a full price table. Lora for headings, Inter for reading. Sample content in English. Works with free Tutor LMS and WooCommerce checkout. WCAG AA colours; calm scroll reveals that respect reduced motion.
